title: Kusuriya no Hitorigoto 2nd Season

alternative_titles.ja: 薬屋のひとりごと 第2期

synopsis:
Using her wit and vast knowledge of medicines and poisons alike, Maomao played a pivotal role in solving a series of mysteries and conspiracies that plagued the imperial court. Having recently come to terms with the secrets of her parents, she returns to fulfill her normal duties on behalf of the emperor's highest-ranking consorts. Maomao also works alongside the eunuch Jinshi to better the consorts' many ladies-in-waiting, including helping them learn to read.

However, with the arrival of a merchant caravan comes a new wave of intrigue. A pattern of strange coincidences involving the visitors and their wares unsettles Maomao, driving her to investigate the puzzling circumstances behind the convoy. As dangers from both outside and within threaten the balance between the imperial concubines, Maomao continues to utilize her cunning and medical expertise to keep the women safe from harm.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
synopsis_es:
Utilizando su ingenio y su vasto conocimiento tanto de medicinas como de venenos, Maomao jugó un papel fundamental en la resolución de una serie de misterios y conspiraciones que plagaron a la corte imperial. Habiendo aceptado recientemente los secretos de sus padres, regresa para cumplir con sus deberes normales en nombre de las consortes de más alto rango del emperador. Maomao también trabaja junto al eunuco Jinshi para mejorar a las muchas damas de honor de las consortes, incluso ayudándolas a aprender a leer.

Sin embargo, con la llegada de una caravana de comerciantes llega una nueva ola de intrigas. Un patrón de extrañas coincidencias que involucran a los visitantes y sus mercancías inquieta a Maomao, lo que la lleva a investigar las desconcertantes circunstancias detrás del convoy. Mientras los peligros tanto externos como internos amenazan el equilibrio entre las concubinas imperiales, Maomao continúa utilizando su astucia y experiencia médica para mantener a las mujeres a salvo de cualquier daño.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]
background: Kusuriya no Hitorigoto 2nd Season aired on Nippon TV's Friday Anime Night block. It was released on Blu-ray in four volumes by Toho from April 16, 2025, to October 15, 2025. The series adapts the third and fourth volume of the light novel.

episodes_data.title: Maomao and Maomao
episodes_data.description: The spring garden party concludes without incident. Maomao returns to her regular life as Concubine Gyokuyou’s taster. Meanwhile, novels become popular in the rear palace. Maomao wonders how this came to be, as novels were typically considered low-class. But behind the scenes lies Jinshi and his goals as manager of the rear palace.

episodes_data.title: Caravan
episodes_data.description: The caravan stirs up excitement in the inner palace. The merchants bring all kinds of goods. However, something gives Maomao a bad feeling.

episodes_data.title: Corpse Fungus
episodes_data.description: A concubine passes away, and a woman goes missing. Jinshi sends Maomao to investigate - not these incidents, but mushrooms growing in the rear palace.

episodes_data.title: Mirrors
episodes_data.description: The special envoy from a foreign land gifts mirrors - a rarity in this country - to the high concubines. However, they bring mysteries as well.

episodes_data.title: Moon Fairy
episodes_data.description: In order to realize the seemingly impossible request from the foreign envoy, Maomao speaks to the “Moon Fairy” herself.

episodes_data.title: The Crystal Pavilion, for the Third Time
episodes_data.title_es: El Pabellón de Cristal, por tercera vez
episodes_data.description: The woman from the clinic finds out that Maomao knows a thing or two about medicine, and asks for her help.

episodes_data.title: The Shrine of Choosing
episodes_data.description: Maomao directs her curiosity towards an old, oddly-shaped building.

episodes_data.title: The Empress Dowager
episodes_data.description: Maomao`s reputation for resolving conflicts reaches the empress dowager, who will ask for her help to unravel a mystery that won`t leave her mind.

episodes_data.title: The Late Emperor
episodes_data.description: Maomao`s investigation of the "curse" reveals more about the late emperor than anticipated.

episodes_data.title: A Ghost Story
episodes_data.description: Maomao joins some women exchanging scary stories on a hot summer night to provide chills.

episodes_data.title: The Hunt
episodes_data.description: Jinshi goes on a hunting trip, and brings Maomao along. He seems ready to share his secret with her.

episodes_data.title: Ka Zuigetsu
episodes_data.description: Maomao discovers Jinshi`s secret. She wants nothing to do with whatever the politcs behind it is.

episodes_data.title: The Baths
episodes_data.description: Xiaolan`s term of service is almost up, so she must find a new job. Maomao and Shisui decide to help.

episodes_data.title: The Dancing Ghost
episodes_data.description: Concubine Lishu reports sightings of a ghost in the baths in her pavilion. Maomao goes to investigate.

episodes_data.title: Ice
episodes_data.description: Xiaolan accidentally ruins an expensive block of ice. Maomao comes up with a delicious backup plan.

episodes_data.title: Festering Resentment
episodes_data.description: Luomen returns to the rear palace. His observations trigger Maomao`s curiosity.

episodes_data.title: The Fox Village
episodes_data.description: Suirei smuggles Maomao and Shisui out of the rear palace. Jinshi begins to search for Maomao.

episodes_data.title: Lantern Plant
episodes_data.description: Maomao has been missing for ten days now. Jinshi`s investigations lead him to a forgetten graveyard.

episodes_data.title: Festival
episodes_data.description: The village holds a festival. Maomao attends, and Shisui introduces some of the village`s history to her.

episodes_data.title: The Stronghold
episodes_data.description: Maomao is taken to a mountain stronghold, where many of the secrets of the Shi clan are revealed to her.

episodes_data.title: Taibon
episodes_data.description: Maomao is accused of attempting to escape, and is tossed into an ancient method of torture and execution.

episodes_data.title: Royal Guard
episodes_data.description: The royal guard, led by Jinshi, arrives, sealing the Shi clan`s fate. Maomao wants to save her friend, Shisui.

episodes_data.title: The Shi Clan
episodes_data.description: Jinshi and his forces infiltrate the stronghold, cornering the remaining Shi clan members.

episodes_data.title: The Beginning
episodes_data.description: After the war, Jinshi`s work piles up and Maomao returns to the pleasure district.
